Author: Rajasekhar Mantha
Bench: Rajasekhar Mantha
04.11.2025
Court No.13
 Item Nos.23-25
 ap
 C.R.A. 14 of 2016
 With
 C.R.A. 15 of 2016
 With
 C.R.A. 52 of 2016
 Mr. Amit Ray,
 Mr. Debapratim Guha,
 Mr. Rajiv Lochan Chakraborty,
 Mr. Sumanta Ganguly,
 Ms. Anchita Sardar.
 ...

Mr. Ranabir Roy Chowdhury,
 Mr. Mainak Gupta.

1.
Let notice be served on the Counsel for the de facto complainant since conviction of the appellants is, inter alia, under Section 376(2)(g) of the Indian Penal Code.

2. List the matter on 11th November, 2025 under the same heading.
3.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
